title: Three-way telepathy experiment between LaMDA and a claimed telepath

tellings.quote: I did actually run one experiment with the LaMDA system uh with someone who claims to have telepathic abilities.

plain: A Google engineer named Blake Lemoine says he once ran an experiment in which LaMDA, Google's conversational AI system, was tested together with a person who claims to have telepathic abilities. Lemoine tells Michels this as something he did himself while working with the system at Google, around 2021 or 2022: "I did actually run one experiment with the LaMDA system," he says. If it showed anything, it would suggest a machine and a mind reader could somehow share information beyond ordinary means.
